reviewType: AI persona trial; not real participant research

persona.role: Father coordinating a youth soccer team end-of-season celebration
persona.experience: Comfortable sending team messages; first-time Live Card creator
persona.goal: Create a cheerful invitation quickly while entering logistics during artwork generation

event.title: Comets Team Celebration
event.openingLine: One team. A season to remember.
event.occasionPreference: Sports if available; otherwise leave optional Occasion unspecified
event.designPrompt: An immersive youth soccer celebration at golden hour on a beautiful community soccer field: a scuffed soccer ball and a pair of cleats in the foreground, a goal and lush green pitch receding into the distance, warm stadium lights starting to glow, navy and bright orange pennants, a few tasteful ribbons and confetti catching the sunset. Rich natural textures, cinematic depth and joyful end-of-season atmosphere. No identifiable people, no team logos or brand marks. Leave a naturally readable area in the upper sky for the exact title and opening line; keep the field and soccer scene richly detailed.
event.messageToGuests: AI demo — not a real event. This fictional Comets team celebration was created for a Live Card usability review. No team gathering is scheduled and no invitation is being sent. Imagine an end-of-season evening celebrating teamwork, effort and a memorable soccer season.
event.additionalGuestNotes: AI demo — not a real event. The online link points to Envitefy for demonstration only. In a real team invitation, I would ask families to bring a water bottle, a camp chair and a favorite season photo, and note any food allergies separately.
event.timezoneVerification: Review showed Oct 26, 2026, 6:30 PM–8:00 PM Event local time. No timezone field was shown for this online event; America/Chicago was the intended test specification but its stored IANA value was not independently verified.

observedFriction: Optional Occasion lacked a broad Sports/team celebration choice; Game day did not precisely match the event, so leaving it unspecified preserved momentum.
Generation status displayed attempt number, elapsed seconds and exact start time above the card after ready; these details did not help complete logistics.
Review offered optional wording corrections without showing the proposed wording in the visible notice, requiring Keep my wording to preserve exact approved text.
Online attendance was entered in a field labelled Venue name; the online result was only explicit after Review.
Copy guest link failed in this browser and its suggested Share invitation fallback also failed. Custom URL remained a successful way to read the address.
execution.downloadVerification: App showed Download started; tool capture timed out after257.2394seconds. No file path recovered. This is incomplete download verification, not evidence that JPEG generation failed.
automationIssues: Initial tab create returned a detachment response, but own new tab existed and was rebound successfully.
Browser typeText dropped characters in long design textarea; corrected with fill and verified exact prompt before the single generation.

Date/time fill alone changed DOM values but did not retain React state after another action. fill plus native ArrowUp/ArrowDown change committed each desired value. Automation-specific behavior; not treated as a human usability finding.
Post-download kernel reset and later extension UI block limited remaining browser verification.

observedFindings: The revised flow avoided duplicate title/opening inputs and allowed real artwork generation to run during logistics entry.
The generated sports scene matched the requested ball, cleats, soccer field, sunset and navy/orange celebration with expressive title lettering.
No generation retry, lettering repair or title revision was needed; one artwork attempt became publishable.
Publication completed through the normal UI and produced the current card URL read from owner controls.
simplificationIdeas: Offer an Online option beside Venue name so virtual events do not need to be entered as if they were physical venues.
Replace the ready job metadata with a compact Your card is ready status; put attempt/time diagnostics behind details.
Show the exact proposed wording and what changes before requesting Apply or Keep wording.
Keep a visible selectable guest URL beside Copy guest link as a fallback when clipboard and native sharing are unavailable.
Retain the current single wording editor and concurrent generation; they reduced repeated entry without removing controls.
review.note: AI father persona executed the real localhost app with actual provider artwork and publication. This is not feedback from a real parent. Public production-origin reachability and guest-page rendering were not independently verified.
